objects.name: crm_activities
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "crm_activities" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar, "kind" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'planned', "subject" varchar, "body" text, "direction" varchar, "phone" varchar, "duration_sec" integer, "location" varchar, "email_meta" text, "recording_file_id" varchar, "transcript" text, "starts_at" datetime, "ends_at" datetime, "owner_id" varchar, "created_by" text not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("owner_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references "wsp_workspaces"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: crm_activities_kind_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_activities_kind_ix ON crm_activities (kind, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_activities_planned_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_activities_planned_ix ON crm_activities (owner_id, starts_at) WHERE status = 'planned' AND deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_activity_targets
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "crm_activity_targets" ("activity_id" varchar not null, "entity_type" varchar not null, "entity_id" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("activity_id") references "crm_activities"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("activity_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"))

objects.name: crm_activity_targets_entity_ix

objects.name: crm_companies

objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_companies_inn_ix ON crm_companies (inn) WHERE inn IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_companies_owner_ix

objects.name: crm_companies_ws_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_companies_ws_ix ON crm_companies (workspace_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_contact_company
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "crm_contact_company" ("id" varchar not null, "contact_id" varchar not null, "company_id" varchar not null, "label" varchar, "is_primary" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("company_id") references "crm_companies"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("contact_id") references "crm_contacts"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: crm_contact_company_company_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX "crm_contact_company_company_ix" on "crm_contact_company" ("company_id")

objects.name: crm_contact_company_contact_id_company_id_uq

objects.name: crm_contact_company_primary_uq
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crm_contact_company_primary_uq ON crm_contact_company (contact_id) WHERE is_primary

objects.name: crm_contacts

objects.name: crm_deal_contacts_primary_uq
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crm_deal_contacts_primary_uq ON crm_deal_contacts (deal_id) WHERE is_primary

objects.name: crm_deals
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "crm_deals" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar, "title" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'open', "pipeline_id" varchar not null, "stage_id" varchar not null, "amount" integer, "currency" varchar not null default 'RUB', "close_date" date, "won_at" datetime, "lost_at" datetime, "lost_reason_id" varchar, "company_id" varchar, "source_id" varchar, "utm" text, "owner_id" varchar, "created_by" text not null, "primary_quote_doc_id" varchar, "forecast_category" varchar, "forecast_category_is_manual" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "stage_entered_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "position" numeric not null default 0, "search" text, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "crm_companies"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("lost_reason_id") references "crm_lost_reasons"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("owner_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("pipeline_id") references "crm_pipelines"("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("source_id") references "crm_sources"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("stage_id") references "crm_stages"("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references "wsp_workspaces"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: crm_deals_close_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_close_ix ON crm_deals (close_date) WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL

objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_company_ix ON crm_deals (company_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_deals_forecast_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_forecast_ix ON crm_deals (workspace_id, owner_id, pipeline_id, close_date, forecast_category) WHERE status = 'open' AND close_date IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_deals_kanban_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_kanban_ix ON crm_deals (pipeline_id, stage_id, position) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_deals_owner_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_owner_ix ON crm_deals (owner_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_deals_ws_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_deals_ws_ix ON crm_deals (workspace_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_leads
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "crm_leads" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar, "title" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default ('open'), "pipeline_id" varchar, "stage_id" varchar, "contact_name" varchar, "phone" varchar, "email" varchar, "company_name" varchar, "amount" integer, "currency" varchar not null default ('RUB'), "source_id" varchar, "utm" text, "lost_reason_id" varchar, "owner_id" varchar, "created_by" text not null, "converted_at" datetime, "converted_deal_id" varchar, "converted_contact_id" varchar, "converted_company_id" varchar, "position" numeric not null default (0), "search" text, "created_at" datetime not null default (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" datetime not null default (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references wsp_workspaces("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("stage_id") references crm_stages("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("source_id") references crm_sources("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("pipeline_id") references crm_pipelines("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("owner_id") references users("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("lost_reason_id") references crm_lost_reasons("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("converted_contact_id") references crm_contacts("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("converted_company_id") references crm_companies("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("converted_deal_id") references "crm_deals"("id") on delete set null on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: crm_leads_kanban_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_leads_kanban_ix ON crm_leads (pipeline_id, stage_id, position) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_leads_owner_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX crm_leads_owner_ix ON crm_leads (owner_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

objects.name: crm_lost_reasons
